project.title: BONO: The Water That Connected Us
project.description: A reflective documentary reconstruction of BONO, a communal drinking-water source in an Ethiopian village in the early 2000s.

narration.voice_description: Natural Amharic voice, calm, warm, reflective and sincere. Measured pace, gentle emotional delivery, like someone remembering an important part of village life.

music.prompt: Original reflective documentary score inspired by the emotional atmosphere of rural Ethiopian village life in the early 2000s. Gentle traditional Ethiopian instrumental textures, subtle krar-inspired plucked strings, warm ambient atmosphere, restrained percussion, nostalgic and hopeful. No vocals. Gradual emotional development, with a quiet ending. Keep space for narration.

shots.visual_prompt: Over-the-shoulder close-up of an Ethiopian weaver's hands guiding a wooden shuttle through crisp white cotton threads on a traditional floor loom inside a dimly lit workshop. Dust motes floating in a single shaft of afternoon sunlight through a wooden window. Rich natural textures, 35mm documentary film look. No identifiable faces.
shots.motion_prompt: Smooth rhythmic camera push-in toward the moving shuttle and taut cotton threads. Natural motion of the hands and wooden loom. Keep the face out of frame.
shots.narration_am: እያንዳንዱ ክር በትዕግሥትና በጥበብ ይሸመን ነበር።
shots.subtitle_en: Every thread was woven with patience and skill.
shots.reason: Captures the craftsmanship and quiet focus of traditional handloom weaving.

shots.visual_prompt: Warm interior view of a vintage 1970s Addis Ababa record shop with wooden shelves packed with vinyl sleeves and cassette tapes, a spinning turntable in the foreground, and soft tungsten lamp light. Retro Amharic signage softly blurred in the background. Nostalgic cinematic documentary aesthetic. No identifiable faces.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow lateral pan across the spinning vinyl record toward the rows of stacked record sleeves. Subtle movement of the tonearm and warm ambient light.
shots.narration_am: በከተማዋ ምሽቶች ሙዚቃ ነፍስን ያድስ ነበር።
shots.subtitle_en: On city evenings, music refreshed the soul.
shots.reason: Establishes the vibrant urban cultural atmosphere of the era.
